Workplace ethics workshop: a bad draft and its redline.

BAD DRAFT

Subject: Urgent compliance concerns about Jordan Lee

Dear Human Resources,

I am writing to report that Jordan Lee has been stealing client reimbursements, leaking confidential files, and intimidating coworkers. On March 4, Jordan submitted a suspicious expense immediately after a client meeting. On March 18, Jordan accessed a restricted folder late at night, and on April 2 Jordan met privately with a vendor. Everyone on the team knows Jordan cannot be trusted. Please suspend Jordan’s access before the evidence disappears and investigate quietly so Jordan cannot coordinate a story. I have always put the company first and am willing to provide more details.

Sincerely,
A concerned colleague

REDLINE

The bad draft is the sort of polished accusation that can make unsupported claims sound official.
